title: Verify the exact Durable Authorized Injection State DDL before any governed migration promotion

phases.objective: Inspect the exact contract-local two-table DDL with the canonical SQL statement parser, bind it to the reviewed Integration and Git blob identities, and emit explicit blockers before a migration candidate can be created.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: The exact contract-local Durable Authorized Injection State DDL and canonical state contract
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: A frozen secret-free readiness packet proves additive table order, constraints, and foreign-key dependency while denying migration creation, promotion, authorization, Apply, and live access.
steps: Bind the inspection to exact Integration and Git blob identities.
Read the canonical state contract and require contract-local, unpromoted, unapplied status.
Split SQL through the canonical migration statement parser.
Require exactly the state table followed by its rollback child table.
Verify primary, unique, index, row-version, no-secret, and foreign-key bindings.
Reject extra, destructive, data-mutating, privilege-changing, executable, or file-system SQL.
Emit checksums and explicit blockers for every later live or mutating stage.
assertions: The exact DDL and state contract produce one frozen readiness packet.
The packet is ready only for creation of a separately reviewed migration candidate.
Wrong source or DDL blob identities fail closed.
Table-name, table-order, foreign-key, and state-contract drift fail closed.
No migration candidate, authorization, dry-run, Apply, live database access, Provider dispatch, deployment, main merge, or Production mutation occurs.

phases.objective: Create and promote a checksum-bound migration candidate only through a separate reviewed slice.
Bind later migration execution and restart reconciliation to exact same-cycle ledger and signed schema-readback evidence.
Observe one separately authorized non-production schema and lifecycle canary after migration Apply and signed readback.
This repository-readiness slice grants no migration, runtime, deployment, main, or Production authority.
